Ensuring a welfare-based Bangladesh crucial to honour 1971 martyrs: Nahid
2026-03-25T21:18:32+06:00 | Star Online Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/politics/news/ensuring-welfare-based-bangladesh-crucial-honour-1971-martyrs-nahid-4135466

National Citizen Party (NCP) Convener and Opposition Chief Whip Nahid Islam today said ensuring an accountable and welfare-based state is essential to honour the martyrs of the Liberation War.

In a message marking the Independence and National Day to be observed tomorrow, Nahid paid tribute to the martyrs of the 1971 Liberation War and the women who suffered persecution during the war.

“With deep respect and gratitude, I remember all the brave martyrs of the great Liberation War, whose immortal sacrifices earned us an independent and sovereign Bangladesh,” he said.

He also greeted Bangladeshis at home and abroad on the occasion.

Nahid said the independence achieved in 1971 was not merely a territorial gain, but a commitment to build a state based on justice, equality, democracy and human dignity.

He said that commitment still remained only partly fulfilled.

According to Nahid, the democratic process in Bangladesh has repeatedly been disrupted by dictatorship and fascism, while attempts were also made at different times to weaken the state and make it subservient to foreign powers.

He said the people of the country had, however, repeatedly risen up in defence of their rights, dignity and freedom.

On the occasion of Independence Day, the NCP leaders also pledged to work towards building an accountable, just and inclusive state system.

Nahid prayed for the peace and prosperity of the country and for the eternal salvation of the martyrs’ souls.
